name: inflight
description: MCP server status and a git worktree list inside the timeline pane: connected, down and sign-in-waiting MCP servers above the milestones; below them each worktree's git state, linked PR, CI and an optional review check, a keep or remove verdict, and a Remove button on a remove verdict.

worktreesRoot.title: Worktrees folder
worktreesRoot.description: A folder whose child folders are worktrees; a leading ~ is your home folder. Empty lists the linked worktrees of the repo the session runs in.

removeCommand.title: Remove command
removeCommand.description: What the Remove button runs, split on spaces and run without a shell from the worktree's main repo. {path} and {name} are filled in; a leading ~ on the program is your home folder.

skipRepos.title: Repos to skip
skipRepos.description: Comma-separated repo names whose worktrees are listed by name only, with no further git or gh calls.

reviewCheck.title: Review check
reviewCheck.description: Exact name of one status check, such as a review bot's, to show on its own line apart from CI. Empty counts every check toward CI.
